title: Split Index — hook rotation (draft mode)
style: data-led, blunt, no hype. Short declarative sentences. Numbers on screen carry the claim.

caption.prompt_text: Write a TikTok caption under 89 characters for a hybrid-fitness analytics app called Split Index. It scores lifting and running on one 0-1000 scale from the user's own logged data. Blunt and specific, no emojis, no hashtag spam, at most one hashtag. Never make medical claims; frame injury risk as relative to the athlete's own baseline.

description.prompt_text: One or two plain sentences expanding the hook for a hybrid athlete audience. State what the app measures and why the number is defensible. No hype, no medical claims.
